episodes.title: Hour 1 - Rum and Gunpowder (1)
episodes.summary: In the premiere episode of this adaptation of Daniel Defoe's classic novel, Crusoe contends with treasure-seeking pirates while Friday plots to rescue him.

episodes.title: Hour 2 - Rum and Gunpowder (2)
episodes.summary: Crusoe contends with treasure-seeking pirates while Friday plots to rescue him.

episodes.title: Hour 3 - Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Crusoe loses his wedding ring while making repairs. Later, Friday asks Crusoe for help returning a woman's spirit to the sea.

episodes.title: Hour 4 - The Mutineers
episodes.summary: Mutineers look for supplies on the island, forcing Crusoe and Friday to defend their home by scaring the group away. Meanwhile, Crusoe hopes to strike a deal with the captain that could send him back to England.

episodes.title: Hour 5 - High Water
episodes.summary: Crusoe and Friday find a boat stuck in a tree. After retrieving it, they begin making repairs and find a working compass.

episodes.title: Hour 6 - Long Pig
episodes.summary: Crusoe has a crisis of conscience when he considers stealing a boat from cannibals who brought captives to the island.

episodes.title: Hour 7 - Bad Blood
episodes.summary: Friday develops an illness that causes him to act out violently, so Crusoe and Olivia search the island for a rare plant that can cure him.

episodes.title: Hour 8 - Heroes and Villains
episodes.summary: The mutineers plan to leave the island, so Crusoe and Friday plot to free the captain and steal the mutineers' boat. But the plan hits a snag because of a traitor in the captain's crew.

episodes.title: Hour 9 - Name of the Game
episodes.summary: Crusoe and Friday reenact tribal challenges from Friday's youth, which bring up painful memories for the tribesman.

episodes.title: Hour 10 - Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.summary: Crusoe is happy but uneasy when Susannah arrives. Later, the pair look for Friday and discover they aren't alone on the island.

episodes.title: Hour 11 - The Hunting Party
episodes.summary: Three warriors hunt Crusoe after stealing a lock of his hair. Friday tries to protect his friend but is soon overwhelmed with the task.

episodes.title: Hour 12 - The Traveler
episodes.summary: Crusoe and Friday rescue men from a capsized boat and discover Mr. Blackthorn is among the group, which raises Friday's suspicions.

episodes.title: Hour 13 - The Return
episodes.summary: Crusoe and Friday defend themselves against Blackthorn and his men in the first-season finale. While Blackthorn looks for Crusoe's personal effects, Crusoe corners Samuel Tuffley and demands information.
